expect: is not a manifest variant of a site-origin slot (hero)
why: Spec 006 §2.5 and TASK-138's split (founder, 2026-10-03, option (a)): only the `hero` slot is served from the site's own origin, so only its variants are committed under `public/media/`. A committed copy of a `productHero` variant is served by nobody — the loader sends that slot to the media bucket — and is weight under the repository cap for nothing (AC-14: every committed byte is a listed variant a page can request). The case supplies one real `productHero` asset's two rows, an empty derived tree and a committed listing holding that asset's AVIF, so the committed-slot rule is the only one that can fire.
